subject: Animation
title: Cinderella Saves the Studio
description: One-minute skill: Cinderella Saves the Studio.

hook.text: By 1950, Disney had not made a hit feature in a decade. The studio was bleeding money badly.

buildup.text: Walt bet everything on Cinderella. If it failed, the studio would likely close its doors forever.

discovery.text: Cinderella combined lush animation with memorable songs and became an immediate global sensation.

twist.text: The profits from Cinderella funded Disneyland, television ventures, and the studio's entire future.

climax.text: One fairy-tale film rescued an empire and gave Disney the resources to dream even bigger.

punchline.text: A glass slipper saved the Magic Kingdom itself.

quiz.question: Why was Cinderella critical to the survival of Disney?
options: It was their first animated film
The studio had not had a hit in a decade and needed Cinderella to avoid closure
It was the first Disney film released internationally
